# T011 — Patch Static Web Apps CLI development chain

## Summary

Refreshed transitive development dependencies with npm, without changing the `@azure/static-web-apps-cli@2.0.7` declaration/resolution, Static Web Apps configuration, or application source. Root audit affected package names fell from 21 (3 critical / 12 high / 4 moderate / 2 low) to 13 (2 / 8 / 1 / 2). Remaining findings are **open**, not accepted. Deployment behavior was not verified.

## Changes (files and why)

- `package-lock.json`: npm-managed updates for the CLI's `concurrently → shell-quote`, `rimraf → glob`, `yaml`, `wait-on → axios → form-data/follow-redirects`, `json-schema-library → fast-copy`, `wait-on → joi`, `selfsigned → node-forge`, and `adm-zip` paths. `lodash` is shared with frontend `recharts` and CLI `concurrently`/`devcert`/`wait-on`. Axios's patched dependency graph brings its own `https-proxy-agent` and `agent-base`; it also upgrades transitive `proxy-from-env` from 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 (major). No direct CLI major upgrade or override was introduced.
- This progress note documents the evidence and unresolved risk.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

`npm explain` before updating established `frontend → @azure/static-web-apps-cli@2.0.7 → concurrently@7.6.0 → shell-quote@1.8.3`, `→ rimraf@5.0.10 → glob@10.4.5`, and `→ yaml@2.8.1`. It also traced `adm-zip` and `cookie` directly to CLI, `tmp` through `devcert`, `node-forge` through `selfsigned`, `joi`/`axios` through `wait-on`, `fast-copy` through `json-schema-library`, and shared `lodash` through CLI and `recharts`. Post-install `npm explain` confirms the same parent paths for shell-quote/glob with patched leaves. Used `npm update --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-save shell-quote yaml rimraf glob axios follow-redirects form-data fast-copy joi lodash adm-zip node-forge`, then `npm ci`; the CLI stays at 2.0.7. npm audit JSON, `npm view` versions and [GitHub advisories for shell-quote](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-395f-4hp3-45gv), [adm-zip](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7q85-xj36-vmfc) and [tmp](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65) were checked on 2026-10-21. The remaining `adm-zip` patch requires 0.6.1 beyond CLI's `^0.5.14`; `cookie` requires >=0.7 beyond `^0.5.0`; `tmp` requires >=0.2.6 beyond devcert's `^0.0.33`; `node-forge` has no published fix for GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv (audit includes 1.4.0). npm audit's suggested CLI 1.1.3 is a **major downgrade**, not a safe compatible fix; forcing transitive majors into certificate/ZIP/deployment code requires a separate decision and testing.

## Validation (commands and results)

Node 24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0; from root after the final lock edit, with `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8` for each command:

- `npm ci` — pass; install warns about old glob/rimraf/sudo-prompt, ESLint 9 support, and install scripts not covered by allowScripts. No force or legacy-peer-deps.
- `npm run build --if-present` — pass; same three pre-existing CSS optimizer warnings.
- `npm test` — **35 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped** (backend 15, frontend 20).
- `npm run lint --if-present` — pass, 0 errors and same five warnings.
- `bash /shared/skills/dependency-vulnerability-remediation/scripts/scan-dependencies.sh --output-dir .modernization-scratch/scan .` — exit **2**, findings rather than an incomplete scan: root 2 critical / 8 high / 1 moderate / 2 low affected package names; backend 0 / 3 / 0 / 0, unchanged. npm audit via scanner, Node/npm versions above, raw results in ignored `.modernization-scratch/scan`. Counts are affected packages, not distinct advisories; do not sum root and backend.
- `git --no-pager diff --check` — pass; no deployment/config files changed.

## Follow-ups and risks

Owner decision needed for the incompatible CLI ZIP/cookie/certificate/temp-file paths and the newest node-forge finding; **none accepted or suppressed**. Do not force npm's downgrade to CLI 1.1.3, override incompatible transitive majors, or claim production deployment verification. Vitest and backend watcher findings remain for their separate task/owner decisions. Patched shared lodash may affect frontend at runtime; transitive `proxy-from-env` 1.1.0 → 2.1.0 via Axios may change CLI proxy routing. Existing tests/build pass, but no service or deployment smoke test was run.
